raw_meta_yaml:
{% set name = "napari-unicell" %}
{% set version = "0.0.1.post3" %}

package:
  name: {{ name|lower }}
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.io/packages/source/{{ name[0] }}/{{ name }}/napari-unicell-{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 4492664fef7f7ca31afee644e1e6a53eaab97ea78af148b76faaa36f78b46095

build:
  noarch: python
  script: {{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv
  number: 0

requirements:
  host:
    - python >=3.8
    - pip
  run:
    - python >=3.8
    - pytorch
    - imagecodecs
    - scipy
    - numpy
    - magicgui
    - qtpy
    - scikit-image
    - monai
    - einops
    - pyqt
    - napari
    - napari-plugin-engine

test:
  imports:
    - napari_unicell
  commands:
    - pip list
    - pip check
  requires:
    - pip

about:
  home: https://github.com/JunMa11/napari-unicell
  summary: universal cell segmentation models
  license: Apache-2.0
  license_file: LICENSE

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - jaimergp
